definitions.explanation: The color yellow. Used as a noun and in compounds. One of the traditional basic colors in Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{黄|き}になった。
⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。

examples.english: In autumn, the ginkgo leaves turn yellow.

notes:
The color yellow, one of the traditional Japanese colors. In everyday speech, ⟦{黄色|きいろ}→黄色：02870_kiiro⟧ (yellow, as a noun) and ⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧ (yellow, as an adjective) are more common than {黄|き} alone. {黄|き} appears mostly in compounds.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{黄色|きいろ}→黄色：02870_kiiro⟧ — yellow (the most common everyday form)
- ⟦{黄金|おうごん}→黄金：14645_ougon⟧/{黄金|こがね} — gold, golden
- ⟦{黄緑|きみどり}→黄緑：15605_kimidori⟧ — yellow-green
- {黄身|きみ} — egg yolk
- ⟦{黄葉|こうよう}→黄葉：21818_kouyou⟧ — yellow autumn leaves
- ⟦{黄砂|こうさ}→黄砂：29892_kousa⟧ — yellow sand/dust (from China)
- ⟦{黄昏|たそがれ}→黄昏：05046_tasogare⟧ — twilight, dusk

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ — shrill voice, high-pitched scream (often of excited fans)
- {黄|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧ — to turn yellow
- ⟦{黄信号|きしんごう}→黄信号：24099_kishingou⟧ — yellow light (traffic signal)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese, the color that English speakers call 'green' for traffic lights is traditionally called ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue). However, the yellow light is called {黄|き} or ⟦{黄色|きいろ}→黄色：02870_kiiro⟧, matching the English term.
